name: High Noon
description: A successful attack has a %chance:pct%% chance to mark its target for %duration% turns. Attacking a marked target consumes the mark and costs no action, dealing %crit_damage:pct%% damage.
details: Only the unit that placed a mark can consume it.
A failed attack neither places nor consumes a mark.

upgrade.summary: Gains an active: unload a flurry of shots into one target.
upgrade.description: Fires %count% attacks at a targeted enemy up to %cast_range% tiles away. Every mark consumed mid-barrage adds one more attack to it.
details: Every shot in the barrage counts as a normal attack, so each one can place or consume a mark on its own.
Each shot in the barrage can also trigger Double Draw.
A target that dies partway through the barrage ends it early - the remaining shots are never fired.
